title: Verify Service Manager only sees App Settings and Wages in Settings
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Manager role. (this role's Settings sub-toggles allow only App Settings and Wages).
Note: Departments grouping is under review (SV-7781).
steps:
1. Click the Settings (cog) icon.
2. Note which sub-sections are listed.
3. Open App Settings.
4. Open Wages.
5. Look for Service, Parts, Finance, and Data Import sub-sections.
expected:
Step 1: Settings opens.
Step 2: Only App Settings and Wages are available.
Step 3: App Settings opens successfully.
Step 4: Wages opens successfully.
Step 5: Service, Parts, Finance, and Data Import do NOT appear (or do not open).
